headline: Rapid Resolution ($198): Fine or demerits reduced—or your fee refunded
payment: The service fee is paid upfront. Payment does not start the 30-day refund clock. No legal outcome is guaranteed.
condition: If the Crown rejects Fabsy's efforts to reduce your original fine or demerits, or withdraw your ticket, and none of those improvements is obtained, Fabsy refunds your service fee within 30 days of receiving the rejection.
declinedOfferText: If the Crown offers a lower fine, fewer demerits, or both and you decline it, you do not qualify for a refund under this guarantee. Refunds under this policy apply only when Fabsy obtains no reduction on your behalf.
scope: Only the $198 Rapid Resolution service, including its discounted Pro Driver orders and its service component in a bundle. Government fines and insurance reports are separate.
